title: Patch: the fuzz starts games the way a dungeon fight does: cards dealt Radiant or Buffed, a hero's health and Armor set, decks of other sizes

**Issue #3283 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3283: Patch: the fuzz starts games the way a dungeon fight does: cards dealt Radiant or Buffed, a hero's health and Armor set, decks of other sizes
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Every dungeon fight starts its game in ways the online and practice games never do:
- some cards in the player's deck begin Radiant or with Buffs;
- the hero starts at the run's health, which may be low, or above the usual 30 once a relic raises it, and may start with Armor;
- either side may open with extra cards or mana;
- a deck can be smaller or larger than 25.

The checker that plays thousands of random games and checks the rules after every step never starts a game like that. A rules bug that only shows from such a start would reach dungeon players unseen.

Once this is built, a share of the checker's games start like a dungeon fight and go through all the same checks. Its report also names the Radiant faces no game ever played.

## Why

- `CreateGameOptions.deck_marks` (`crates/engine/src/state.rs:2154-2159`, R2702000) deals cards Radiant or Buffed at setup.
- `run_fight_setup` (`crates/run/src/fight.rs:117-170`) also sets:
  - the human's `hero_health` to the run's HP and the enemy's to its own;
  - Armor, opening cards and crystals from Combat relics and curses (R2922001, R181, R182, R2922000);
  - deck sizes from the run's own deck.
- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` sets none of these: `deck_marks`, `hero_health` and `hero_armor` do not appear in it. `handicap_for_seed` (`fuzz.rs:3117-3133`) only rotates `AI_DIFFICULTY`'s Medium and Hard, whose `hero_health` and `hero_armor` are `None`.
- The only code that plays these setups is `run-sim` (`crates/tools/src/run_sim.rs`). It plays AI against AI with no invariant monitor: `PR_FIGHTS` fights per pull request and `DAILY_SEEDS` runs a day. The monitor's only callers are `fuzz.rs`, `duos_fuzz.rs` and `fused_pairs.rs`.
- The coverage line (#2426) counts card ids (`note_played`, `fuzz.rs:2367`), so a Radiant face that never resolved does not show, though `cardResolved` already carries `radiant`.
- This is not #1693's combination of dealt seats, last boards and Glitch boards. Those inputs are already fuzzed, while these are fuzzed by no monitored game at all.

## Proposal

- On a share of seeds in both 1v1 waves (`RUN_START_SHARE`, strawman 0.15), the fuzz draws a dungeon-style setup from a stream of its own, so no existing seed's game moves. The setup holds:
  - deck marks on some cards of each deck: Radiant, and Buffs up to a small bound;
  - a hero health from low to above the usual starting health, and some starting Armor;
  - extra opening cards and crystals within the bounds the run's own effects reach;
  - a deck size other than `DECK_SIZE`, within the handicap's legal range.
- The setup goes to the fold, so the replay hash check folds it too. `FoldArgs` already carries `deck_marks` and `handicaps`.
- The summary's `starts:` line and `--json`'s `starts` count these games. A failure prints the marks and handicaps, and `--from N --seeds 1` replays them.
- The `coverage:` line adds the Radiant faces of dealt pool cards that no game resolved, read from `cardResolved`'s `radiant`. It never fails a seed.
- New numbers are named constants beside `START_STATE_SHARE`. Run bounds are read from the run crate's config where one exists.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` and its tests.
- The fuzz row of `crates/tools/README.md`.
- `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, only if a monitor check assumes a hero starts at the standard health.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On `RUN_START_SHARE` of seeds a game starts with deck marks and a run-style handicap. A unit test shows that such a seed's start is the same on every run, and that every seed outside the share deals exactly as before.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` passes with the new starts, and the summary counts them.
- [ ] `--from N --seeds 1` replays such a seed with its marks and handicap.
- [ ] The coverage line and `--json` name the Radiant faces no game resolved.
- [ ] The tools README row describes the new starts.

## Size and risks

Medium, mostly `fuzz.rs`, 2 to 3 files. The seed count is unchanged, so CI time stays the same.

Risks:
- It may find real bugs, which then need fixing before it can merge. That is its point, and each one becomes its own issue.
- A Glitch reset re-deals marked Buffs (R2702000), so the builder decides whether a Glitch start and a run start may share a seed, and says so.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `fuzz` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

<!-- jackioh-bot -->

approve
```

# Draft plan for #3283 (planner's working notes; final message is the plan)

## Settled design (all in crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs + README row 15)
- NEW `StartKind::Run` ("run"), 5th in START_KINDS (not in DRAWN_STARTS). `with_drawn_start` first checks stream `run-start-` `.chance(RUN_START_SHARE=0.15)` -> Run, else the old `start-` draw untouched. No combining with dealt/last/glitch boards (a dungeon fight has none).
- Decks: new `GameSetup::decks(&self, forced: usize)`: Run -> own stream `run-start-decks-`, sizes RUN_START_DECK_MIN(10=RUN_STARTER_SIZE)..=MAX(60=RUN_DECK_MAX), floored at forced count, dealt from FUZZ_POOL by deal_deck; else old decks_for_seed / handicap_decks_for_seed. fuzz_seed / fuzz_handicap_seed use it.
- create_options Run arm: `run_start_inputs(rng(start-inputs-), self.handicaps(), &decks)` -> handicaps (layered on rotation's) + deck_marks. fold_args must also copy deck_marks.
- Coverage: radiant set from CardResolved{radiant:Some(true)}; GameRun.radiant (4 test literals need field); Coverage.with_radiant; radiant_line(); json adds radiantResolved/neverRadiant (update one existing assert_eq).
- Failure report/json: handicaps+marks recomputed via run_start_note(failure) (no new Failure field).
- Python replica of Rng (/tmp/rngprobe/probe.py, verified vs Rust golden vectors) gives pins: gate seeds 1..=20 starts = plain, glitch-boards, last-boards, plain, glitch-boards, RUN, RUN, dealt, plain, plain, dealt, dealt, plain, RUN, last-boards, glitch-boards, dealt, plain, glitch-boards, dealt; handicap 1..=20 = plain, dealt, dealt, glitch-boards, dealt, dealt, dealt, plain, RUN(9; old last-boards), last-boards, plain x5, glitch-boards(16), last-boards(17), plain x3. Run seeds in 1..=200: gate 31, handicap 27. 4679 (handicap) not Run; seeds 1-4 not Run either wave; gate 7 IS Run (a_game_setup_names_the_streams... only uses stream names + handicaps() which stays rotation-only).
- No ruling/fragment/catalog change. Rating: medium (tools only), caveat real bugs found -> reported, not hidden.

## Status: ready to write the final plan.
